<b>Wreath of Purity</b> is a {{CrestSlot|Blue|1}} in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>. It provides protection against [[Muckmaggot]] infestation.

== Usefulness ==
Generally grants immunity to 3<ref group = Source><code>MAGGOT_CHARM_MAX_HITS</code></ref> 'hits' from [[Muckmaggot|Muckmaggots]], as indicated by the dwindling status of the Wreath. 

* Infestation from [[Disgraced Chef Lugoli]]'s Muckmaggot Lump attacks counts as 1 'hit' (mask damage is not negated). 
* Soaking in infested water for 6 seconds accumulates to 1 'hit', 0.5 seconds are added to the timer each time [[Hornet (Silksong)|Hornet]] enters or re-enters the water<ref group = Source><code>maggotCharmHealthLossTime</code> and <code>maggotCharmEnterWaterAddTime</code> in <code>globalsettings_assets_all.bundle</code>.</ref>.

Its HUD icon disappears when broken. Resting at a [[Bench (Silksong)|Bench]] or acquiring a new [[Mask Shard (Silksong)|mask]] fully repairs the Wreath and resets the 'hit' counts.

Despite the time punishment from entering infested water repeatedly, hopping across water quickly still has advantage over swimming through it. The Wreath is able to withstand approximately 27 instant touchings of infested water.

== How to Acquire ==
Found in [[Putrified Ducts]], in the passage below and to the right of the [[Bellway]] station on the corpse of a bug.

== Trivia ==
* The Wreath is found next to the corpse of a bug who looks similar to the [[Pinstress]] and [[Seamstress]], possibly a member of the Order of the Pinstress. This is further indicated by the style of the pin in the background, and the hut itself bears a notable resemblance to their huts.
* Bellway travel resets the Wreath's durability. Despite sharing a description stating it "will be repaired while resting at a bench" [[Fractured Mask]] does not share this quality.
** Other methods which reset Wreath durability include using the [[Beastling Call]] and gaining a new [[Mask Shard (Silksong)|mask]].
* While the Tool description states that the Wreath is 'fragile', Muckmaggot exposure is the only thing that damages it.
* The Wreath is referred to as 'Poultice Pouch' in the game files.
* Prior to <code>1.0.29120</code>, it only took 3 seconds for the Wreath to get damaged once when in infested water.
* The Wreath of Purity sheds the same leaves as those dropped by the tall, whitish plants in Bilewater that [[Mothleaf Lagnia]] mimic.
